Finding concentration round (triage seat, session `session_01Kktexqp6uVuFMztvvTMf3V`, 2026-08-24, maintainer-invoked): promoted → `pm:queue` + `domain:engine`, Task (S). All four items are consequences of one `getMany` switch; single PR, declared file surface: `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` (param JSDoc) + `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts` (`SettingsReadSurface` prose) + the leg-count pin + resolution-context note. Cross-domain designation by triage (core+rest in one S card): engine seat carries it; file surface above is the claim-comment surface.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01VK8rFDtg8eREaxBGX99Csn`
Branch: `claude/issue-11222-localization-getmany-declarations`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-11222`
Domain: `domain:engine`
File surface: `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` + `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.test.ts` + `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (tier: `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on this surface returns **no path-derived mandate**, quoted not recalled. Two declaration lines are mechanical, but the leg-count rig is a measurement device that has to reverse-verify, and a rig that cannot fail is worse than no rig.)
Clause-②: no — two declarations are corrected to match what the consumer already calls, plus test-only assertions. No accept/reject behaviour moves and no public surface widens; the runtime path is untouched.
Serial constraints cleared: **no open PR touches either production file.** All 21 open PRs enumerated and their diffs read; the matcher's positive control is #11659 at 9 changed files. Sibling read-coupling, named because file-disjointness does not cover it: **#11580 / PR #11623** (`domain:cli`) moves *when* the MCP stdio transport reads localization settings — it does not touch this resolver and asserts nothing about its call shape, so this card's pins cannot be flipped by it landing. **#11588** (`domain:cli`, rest sandbox error wrapper) is in `packages/rest` but not in `rest-api-plugin.ts`.

## Directed in-flight check — required, because this is a triage-designated cross-domain card

Triage designated this a single S card spanning `core` + `rest` and assigned it to this seat by name (2026-08-24 promotion comment). Per the cross-domain exception path, the directed in-flight check runs over the lanes this surface touches — `domain:engine` (core) and `domain:cli` (rest):

- `domain:engine` in flight: **#11374**, **#11145** (this seat, same round). #11374's surface is `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**`; #11145's is `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`. Neither intersects this card's three files.
- `domain:cli` in flight: #11596, #11588, #11580, #11546, #11317, #11032, #10243. Of these, the ones with open PRs were checked by diff and none touches `rest-api-plugin.ts` or `resolve-authz-context.ts`. ⚠️ Honest bound on this reading: cards without a pushed PR expose no diff, so for those the check is "no declared overlap", not "measured disjoint".

## Premises re-verified on the merged ref

`origin/main` @ `cad8b42`. Both declaration sites are live and both still under-state the consumer:

- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:650` — the param JSDoc still says the service exposes `get(namespace, key, ...)`.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts:60` — `interface SettingsReadSurface` is still declared, and still consumed at 327/329 via `ctx.getService`.
- `getMany` occurs **5x** in the resolver, so the switch this card follows did land and the declarations really are the stale half.

## The measurement rig is already written, and it has a trap in it

The card's own thread carries a salvaged, reverse-verified leg-count rig (comment `5384105106`) from a discarded duplicate dispatch. It is the hard part of item 2 and should not be rebuilt from scratch. ⚠️ Two documented hazards, both from the author:

1. It was written against **pre-#11208** source and needs rebasing onto the landed `getMany` path; `EXPECTED` / `VALUES` / `makeCountingQl` already exist in the target test file.
2. ⛔ Its generic type arguments are written with **square** brackets (`Record[string, unknown]`, `Array[{ … }]`) because this repo has measured GitHub's sanitizer eating short angle-bracket fragments **even inside fenced code**. They must be restored to angle brackets when pasted. Pasting it verbatim will not compile.

The rig's whole value is that it reverse-verified: against pre-fix source the AFTER case failed with `expected { queries: 3, legs: 1 } to deeply equal { queries: 1, legs: 1 }`. A leg pin that has never been seen red is not a pin.

## Scope note carried from the card

Item 1 (the two declarations) and items 2-3 (test-only) are in scope. **Item 4** — the partial-manifest `getMany` all-or-nothing failure — the card itself flags that it may belong on `getMany`'s own contract rather than at this call site, since the validation is the service's behaviour and this caller is merely its first consumer. That judgement is the dev's to make and report; if it lands in the settings service it is a `domain:services` card, ⛔ not a silent widening of this PR.

## H17 on-hold trigger index — zero intersection

Intersected against all 17 indexed holds on the patrol anchor (#9857). No hit. ⚠️ Note the near-miss deliberately checked: hold **#7898** indexes `packages/core/src/security/auth-gate.ts` — a **different file** in the same directory as this card's resolver. Same folder is not the trigger; the indexed path is.
